title: hyacinthella micrantha
intro: Hyacinthella micrantha, commonly known as the Alpine Harebell, is a species of flowering plant in the bellflower family. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its sedative effects. Bioactive constituents found in Hyacinthella micrantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
